name: Lil Oldman
source:
Lil Oldman is an eccentric wizard. He comes off as strange and is often blunt, possessing a mysterious wisdom that makes him appear two steps ahead. He takes particular interest in [url=/c143276]Flippy[/url] and his abilities as a leader. 

[spoiler]His methods for preventing the killing game come off as extreme, such as wanting to hypnotize everyone into avoiding murder.[/spoiler]
